**PotentialNoise 2.0.0**, the first public release (the renamed, re-styled Pink Noise).

A calibrated pink noise reference for mixing: one-tap RMS levels, mono or stereo, full or limited range, and a live meter. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialnoise#readme) for how to use it.

**Download** `PotentialNoise-2.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip` below. It's for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs on MPC OS 3.x and has been tested on an MPC One. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.

Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome. [Open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialnoise/issues/new/choose).
